We decided to erect polls carrying power lines with enough energy flowing through them to instantly kill just about anything through the entire country. JFK announced America's intention to put a man on the moon within a decade when there'd only been 5 humans in space and just months after we'd first managed to put our first man into orbit. This announcement and project in general is something on the sort of scale and ambition not seen in this country for a very long time.

Spec Comparison

A current SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket can carry about 25 tons to low earth orbit. The Lockheed/Boeing rocket, Atlas 5, can carry 20 tons to low earth orbit. Both can get a little less than 10 tons to geostationary orbit. Even the rocket that got us to the moon, the Saturn V, is nowhere near strong enough.
